A clear notice about floor markings
It is for pet owners

Travel Notice for Pet Owners

Travelers need to follow the floor markings near the Companion Animal Travel Desk so pets, carriers, and handlers move safely and without confusion. Please pause at the marked points, keep walkways open, and listen for guidance before you head onward.

Passengers receive clear guidance before departure. The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions. Staff record service changes in the desk ledger. If you are traveling with a pet, please bring the carrier, leash, and approved documents to the desk before boarding begins. Calm handling helps staff give steady support to each traveler and animal.

At Thornwick, the relief area is available for pet use, and staff will guide you to the correct entrance when needed. Please keep pets close and follow all posted markings, as they are placed to protect travelers, animals, and airport movement. If you have any concern about access or pet care, a staff member will answer it with care.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for personal guidance before you proceed to the gate.
